appCommitNote: perf/m1-first-numbers at the per-request metrics commit; the perf tooling commits on top (run.sh snapshot/restore/pgss/k6, the k6 scenario, docs) change no server code, so the app under test is feb13b52 exactly

dataset.slice: M1 (users, teams, careers, review periods, reviews, 1:1s, goals, feedbacks, notifications)
dataset.snapshot: perf/snapshots/lettuce-perf-v1-2026-10-01-s1-x1.0.dump (193 MB, git-ignored); every run starts from perf/run.sh restore
dataset.rows: perf/results/seed-1.json (users 522, teams 84, performance_reviews 5100, one_on_one_meetings 132600, notes 397800, action items 429868, goals 30600, feedbacks 30660, notifications 34132)

machine.cpu: Apple M5 Max (18 cores, 128 GB host)
machine.vm: 18 CPUs, 16 GB (shared by every container, including k6)

postgres.observerOverheadNote: auto_explain.log_analyze=on instruments EVERY statement (row counting + buffer usage; per-node timing is off via log_timing=off) and pg_stat_statements + track_io_timing add a little per call, so absolute database milliseconds are inflated slightly; statement and transaction counts are exact and unaffected. No statement of any window exceeded 50 ms (max_exec 7.2 ms), so every auto_explain file was empty (not committed).

scenario.name: reviews-team-view
scenario.noIC: an IC never sees the Team's-performance tab (Performance.tsx showManagedTab = isManager || auditor); ICs belong to the M2 scenarios
scenario.coldLoad: every iteration is a cold screen load (no client cache)
scenario.warmup: 3 iterations over every persona, not recorded (after a run.sh restore)
scenario.oneVu: 1 VU x 3 iterations per persona, pgss window around each run
scenario.fiftyVu: mixed 3m, ceo-all 2m, director-all 1m, lead 1m, hr 1m; closed loop, no think time (a saturation run, not a realistic mix)
scenario.extra: saturation-docker-stats.txt: a 60 s mixed 50-VU run sampled with docker stats every 4 s (CPU of app and postgres)
scenario.completeRuns: 2nd complete run (the 1st, with an IC persona in the mix, was superseded); summaries carry no setup_data or bearer tokens (a grep for the JWT prefix over perf/baselines is empty)

caveat: OrbStack on one laptop is not production: compare milliseconds relatively, statement/transaction counts exactly. Baselines compare only within one datasetVersion.
